title: The Ruined Temple
description: Scholar Tera Voss has been studying the Jedi Temple on Coruscant for years. She believes there's an artifact still hidden within—something the Empire missed during their purge. The Temple is dangerous to enter, filled with traps and Imperial remnants, but she thinks you're meant to find it. Will you help her recover it?
shortDescription: Recover a powerful artifact from the ruined Jedi Temple

objectives.description: Meet with Scholar Tera Voss at the Temple District
Travel to the Jedi Temple ruins
Reach the inner sanctum of the ruined temple where the artifact is hidden
Find the ancient key to the artifact chamber (search defeated enemies or find in hidden caches)
Defeat the ancient temple guardian protecting the artifact
Recover the Jedi artifact from the sanctum
Choose what to do with the artifact (return to scholar, keep it, or destroy it)
